THE CUE, one sentence placed where an agent reads it before any call: the server's connect-time instructions (every harness, every session) and the kit's SessionStart text (tools/loop_nudge.py: Claude Code's hook and VS Code's terminal route). It names `graph_report_markdown` as the first read for where the design stands, and `search_design` for the design's OWN record of its current state when the design keeps one ("current state", "status as of").

WHY THAT READ, from what reflow2 already serves, measured on the recall pilot's finished design (422 nodes, published 0.93.1): graph_report_markdown 6,288 bytes (what the design holds, delivered N of M, top gaps), graph_report 14,266, open_questions 8,080, loop_status 7,641, what_next 1,442; the where-am-i skill is a 20 KB procedure of a dozen reads. graph_report_markdown is the only compact one that says where the design stands. NONE of them returns the subject's current values (the hand-written "CURRENT VALUES …" record the reader needed): that is a finding, recorded, not built here. search_design "current state" ranks the design's own state records first on that design, which is why the cue names it second.
